'''This droid''' was part of the reinforcements sent to the planet of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] to deal with the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebels]] when the power generators of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] were destroyed. After the failed [[Death/Legends|execution]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]], the rebels fled into the highlands to keep the battle away from the city. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]] ordered battalions of droids and several [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|droid gunships]] to take out the rebels.

While the rebels were busy defending their base from the approaching droids, a droid gunship carrying this commando droid and another [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droid]] arrived at the nest and killed all the rebels present. This droid wounded the lone surviving rebel to get the information of where the king was being held and was forced to execute the [[Unidentified female Onderonian rebel/Legends|rebel]] when she would not talk.

King Dendup and his royal guards made an attempt to flee when [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] showed up and distracted the droid gunship long enough to shoot it down, but the commando droids gave chase. All three of Dendup's guards were killed but Steela took out the last commando droid just before it reached the king.
